messages:
erin: quick design thread 7 — debating compact run-card output vs full side panel for tool-calls. thoughts?
sam: compact inline is fast for scanning. show only the first key/value and tool icon, then an affordance to open details.
raj: agree but if users need actions (rerun, copy, debug) panel is better. hybrid: inline summary + 'Open details' launches panel.
tia: accessibility checklist: (1) expand control must be a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls, (2) panel should get focus and set aria-modal if needed, (3) announce "Details opened" via aria-live polite.
erin: microcopy: use 'Open details' for the action, and label expand buttons 'Expand output' for clarity with screen readers.
a11y-bot: quick scan: missing aria-controls ids and no reduced-motion handling on the demo animation (low severity).
raj: perf note: virtualize run list and only mount expanded outputs. lazy-load heavy content in panel.
erin: action items: design provide compact summary token + reduced-motion variant, eng implement aria props + virtualization, content finalize microcopy. will add a tiny spec and e2e keyboard test.
